steps.name: set-styles
steps.eval: (() => { const st=window.__store.getState(); const fp=st.floorPlan; const doors=fp.openings.filter(o=>o.kind==='door'); const wins=fp.openings.filter(o=>o.kind==='window'); doors.forEach(d=>window.__store.getState().updateOpening(d.id,{style:'glazed'})); wins.forEach(w=>window.__store.getState().updateOpening(w.id,{style:'grille'})); return JSON.stringify({doors:doors.length, windows:wins.length}); })()
